comment: Canonical MCP server registry for Walter-OS. Verified against npm/pypi 2026-05-04. The install.sh script generates per-tool configs (~/.claude/settings.json mcpServers + ~/.codex/config.toml) FROM this file. Edit here, not in the generated files. NEW: github + linear are remote MCPs (HTTP/SSE) using vendor-hosted official servers.

github.comment: Official GitHub MCP (remote HTTP). Uses GitHub Copilot infrastructure. Replaces the deprecated @modelcontextprotocol/server-github npm package.

filesystem.comment: Read-write access to project directories. Restrict scopes above.

linear.comment: Official Linear MCP (remote SSE, OAuth-based). First connect opens browser to authorize. Replaces @tacticlaunch/mcp-linear community package.

plane.comment: Official from Plane (publisher: plane-engineering). Self-hosted Plane on Walter-VM.

supabase.comment: Official from Supabase. For personal-project Postgres + auth + storage.

gmail.comment: Auto-OAuth flow on first use. Place Google Cloud OAuth client JSON at the credentials path.

notion.comment: Official from Notion. Token from notion.so/my-integrations.

elevenlabs.comment: Official from ElevenLabs. Python package via uvx (NOT npm). Pinned to ==0.9.1; bump deliberately after `daily-supply-chain-audit` confirms the new release is >= minReleaseAge old.

bitwarden.comment: Official from Bitwarden. Compatible with self-hosted Vaultwarden via BW_SERVER. Run 'bw login' + 'bw unlock' to get BW_SESSION.

grafana.comment: Official from grafana/mcp-grafana (Go binary). Install: brew install grafana/grafana/mcp-grafana. Replaces @leval/mcp-grafana community package.

sentry.comment: Read errors, search issues, resolve/ignore. Read-only by default — no deletion of issues.

stripe.comment: Stripe payments for personal projects. Use TEST mode key (sk_test_...) by default. LIVE mode key only via separate config — operator confirms each LIVE action.

cloudflare.comment: DNS, Workers, R2, Zero Trust. DNS changes can break sites — operator confirms each change. Scope token to specific zones.

playwright.comment: E2E tests + scraping + screenshots. Microsoft official. No env required — uses locally installed browsers (run 'npx playwright install' once).

sequential_thinking.comment: Chain-of-thought scaffolding for complex problems. Free, no env needed.

memory.comment: Knowledge-graph memory across sessions. Complements the file-based memory in ~/.claude/projects/.../memory/ — that one is curated by the agent, this one is automatic.

brave_search.comment: Web search via Brave (privacy-respecting, free tier 2k queries/mo). Alternative when WebSearch not available.

penpot.comment: Open-source Figma alternative. Self-hostable on Walter-VM. Read/edit design files, export assets, manage components.

maestro.comment: Maestro YAML flows for mobile (iOS/Android) AND web UI testing. Requires Maestro CLI installed locally (bootstrap.sh handles via brew tap mobile-dev-inc). Complements Playwright — use Maestro for E2E user-journey-style tests, Playwright for fine-grained DOM/network control + visual regression.

context_routing.work: Loaded only when cwd matches ~/work/* or remote is ${WALTER_WORK_GITHUB_ORG}

trust_levels.official-vendor: Maintained by the service vendor (Notion, Plane, Supabase, ElevenLabs, Bitwarden)
trust_levels.community-popular: Community-maintained, widely used (gmail has high download count)
trust_levels.community: Community-maintained, fewer signals — verify before sensitive use

verification_method: npm view <pkg> version + npm search for canonical names

deferred.comment: These services were on the original wish list but lack a trustworthy MCP server as of verification date. Revisit periodically.
deferred.mattermost: Only @dakatan/mcp-mattermost@0.0.5 available (single-version, immature). Use REST API directly for now.
deferred.postman: mcp-postman is just a Newman runner, not a full MCP. Use Postman directly.
deferred.vercel: Dropped MCP (community @robinson_ai_systems/vercel-mcp@1.0.1 not maintained — single version, last updated long ago). Use vercel CLI directly + the vercel-cli skill (skills/vercel-cli/SKILL.md).
deferred.postgres: Dropped MCP — only 7 GitHub stars, single maintainer. Use psql CLI directly + skills/postgres-cli/SKILL.md.
deferred.hetzner: Dropped MCP — only 1 star, very young. Use hcloud CLI (official, brew installable) + skills/hcloud-cli/SKILL.md.
deferred.telegram: Dropped MCP — @overpod/mcp-telegram@1.36.0 ran in MTProto user-bot mode = full read/write access to ALL personal chats. Too much surface for an agent. Use Bot API directly (bot only sees chats it's been added to) via skills/telegram-bot-cli/SKILL.md.
deferred.obsidian: Dropped MCP — community @fazer-ai/mcp-obsidian@1.2.0 needs the Local REST API plugin running 24/7. With Forgejo-synced vault, the agent reads/writes via filesystem MCP directly on the Obsidian folder. Simpler.
deferred.forgejo: Dropped MCP — community forgejo-mcp@1.2.0. Forgejo ships an official `tea` CLI (Gitea-compatible). Use that + skills/forgejo-cli/SKILL.md.
deferred.railway: Dropped MCP — community railway-mcp@2.2.0. Railway ships an excellent official CLI. Use that + skills/railway-cli/SKILL.md.
